🔥 Monster Invasion Is Here! Rally Your Forces and
Take on the Threat!

Starting August 17, a massive wave of monsters will
sweep across the Kingdom! Monsters will appear
throughout the World Map, and all Lords can join the
hunt. After defeating monsters, you may encounter
powerful enemies ranging from Lv. 1–5. Rally your
troops and drive them out together!

🎟️ Hunt Monsters, Earn Exchange Tickets
Join the hunt to earn event Exchange Tickets, which
can be used to redeem exciting rewards in the Event
Shop!

🏆 Compete for Points
Defeat monsters to earn points and compete in the
Personal, Guild, and Kingdom Rankings for even more
rewards!

🎁 Contribute to Your Kingdom
Earn Kingdom Points together and reach milestone
goals to claim corresponding Kingdom Rewards!

⚔️ The Monster Invasion Has Begun!
Rally your troops, fight together, defend your
Kingdom, and claim tons of rewards!
